newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Midwest direct hogs seen steady-weak -dealers.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Midwest direct hogs seen steady-weak -dealers.

text.p: Midwest direct cash hog prices Monday were seen steady to weak amid pressure from this week's large hog marketings and lower pork prices, which eroded packer operating margins, livestock dealers said.
Iowa and southern Minnesota top prices for hogs delivered to plants could range from $51.00 to $52.50 per cwt.
Illinois top prices at the plant could range from $50.50 to $51.00 and Indiana/Ohio top prices were seen at $50.00 to $50.50, sources there said.
But losses Monday could be tempered by lighter marketings as producers resist weak prices by holding back hogs.
